summary: Every rank parses the same -i count, receives a contiguous row/CSR slice from the global partition, and executes the timed SpMV loop that many times. Native host assembly retains the repetition loop and row/nonzero loops with CSR loads, multiply-adds, and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: The parsed iteration count is used by the timed loop on each rank; rank row ranges start at row zero and end at numRows with row counts and matching nnz displacement/counts, then local row delimiters are rebased and local SpMV is repeated before gathering.
The local CPU SpMV traverses all rows in its supplied dimension and each row's half-open CSR interval, accumulating val[j]*vec[cols[j]] and writing out[i].

compiled_evidence.claim: The timed native control brackets an outer iteration loop with barriers/time reads; within it, compiled row and nonzero loops load column indices, vector and matrix values, multiply/add, store each row output, and branch across rows and iterations.

primary_quality_check.method: Primary directly inspected all four pilot programs: parsed iteration counts, timed host repetition loops, complete CSR row/nonzero traversals and output stores. Inspected emitted CPU/OpenMP repetition and row/nonzero backedges; CUDA and hybrid host dispatch backedges, device CSR loads, DFMA loops/backedges and stores. Checked contiguous MPI/rank/GPU row partitions and rebased CSR slices. Repeated overwrites of A*x match the unchanged reference. No execution or recompilation.

checked_examples.omp: Source 200-218, 278-284, 339-355; host 703-735 and 1095-1172 include actual repetition and row/nonzero loops.
checked_examples.mpi: Source 99-109, 178-185, 232-303, 317-340; inlined native host 2185-2233 retains all three nested loops.
checked_examples.cuda: Source 133-182, 200-214, 276-281, 348-368; host 1401-1425; vector device loop backedge 167/store 279 and scalar backedge 388/store 968 with CSR loads and DFMA.
checked_examples.hybrid: Source 151-188, 261-277, 348-350, 438-483, 506-518; host 3376-3438, 3462-3469; device row bounds/CSR loads/DFMA at 19-145, backedge 425 and store 885.
